subject: science
concept: Designing and conducting a quantitative investigation involving stoichiometry or solution concentration
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student conducts a simple, safe investigation involving measured reactant amounts and records quantitative results
exercise.pictorial: Student charts their investigation's measured versus predicted results
exercise.abstract: Student compares their investigation's actual yield to the theoretical yield calculated from stoichiometry, and explains any difference

assessment.mastery_threshold: explanation for any yield discrepancy is scientifically plausible (measurement error, incomplete reaction) rather than dismissed
misconception_flags: expects experimental and theoretical yield to match exactly with no explanation offered for real-world discrepancies

interest_binding: investigation topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
